maya (CSE): Quick flag: Clarion onboarding summary flow p95 ~2.2s vs our 800ms SLO. Renewal watch.
dan (SRE): Hosted or Dedicated? Any token patterns? :eyes:
lee (ML Eng): Hosted, model redwood-open-xl-v1. Typical input ~3k tokens; many repeated prefixes -> high KV miss.
maya (CSE): Saw a usage spike after their nightly ingest.
ravi (AE): Clarion cares about cost; would prefer latency improvements first. They may consider on-prem later.
dan (SRE): Short wins: enable route-level prefix KV caching (TTL 12h). Also create a canary routing rule.
lee (ML Eng): Proposed plan:
- Canary int8 variant redwood-open-xl-v1-int8 at 10% for clarion summaries
- Route very long docs (>2500 tokens) to redwood-compact-xl-qa with light prompt rewrite
- Run 20-sample eval for quality guardrails
maya (CSE): Can we draft a short customer note explaining tradeoffs and rollback plan?
ravi (AE): I'll schedule a 30m touchpoint Wed 11:00 PT and ask for their top 10 sample docs.
eng-runtime-bot: deploy request: canary redwood-open-xl-v1-int8 -> 10% via policy "clarion-int8-canary" queued.
dan (SRE): I'll enable KV cache and stage the routing rule: if input_tokens > 2500 && customer_id=="clarion" -> redwood-compact-xl-qa (10%).
lee (ML Eng): Eval snapshot (20 samples):
```
float p95 2200ms ROUGE-L 0.73
int8 p95 1200ms ROUGE-L 0.72
compact p95 950ms ROUGE-L 0.695
```
Quality delta small; latency win notable.
maya (CSE): Customer wording idea: "We can run a short pilot to reduce tail latency and cost by testing a quantized variant and routing very long documents to a compact model. We will monitor quality and can roll back instantly."
ravi (AE): Add FAQ: expected cost delta, risk, rollback steps, impact on tokens.
lee (ML Eng): Rollback plan: set canary to 0%, revert routing rule. Create alert: ROUGE-L drop >1.2% -> notify @lee @maya.
dan (SRE): Ops checklist:
- [x] KV cache enabled (TTL=12h)
- [x] Routing rule staged (10% canary)
- [x] Int8 canary deployed
- [ ] Monitoring dashboard (latency/cost/ROUGE) - I will deliver EOD
eng-runtime-bot: alert clarion-canary-quality created -> notify @lee @maya on ROUGE-L delta > 1.0%
maya (CSE): I'll send Clarion the pilot note and request acceptance testing window 48h.
ravi (AE): On the call I'll collect their sample docs and sign-off criteria. If they accept, we can propose a reserved capacity discount as renewal incentive.
lee (ML Eng): Also recommending embedding-level caching if we see embedding compute as a hotspot; I'll add instrumentation.
dan (SRE): I'll surface embedding compute time in the dashboard. If KV hit rate <25% after 12h, we'll revisit.
maya (CSE): Owners: Lee -> evals & guardrails; Dan -> ops & dashboard; Ravi -> customer comms/renewal; Maya -> enablement doc. Ticket updated.
eng-runtime-bot: ticket CS-71420 updated: assignments set (Lee, Dan, Ravi, Maya). Canary window 8h.
maya (CSE): Thanks all. Ping here with any critical alerts during the canary. :thumbsup:
